issues.on_page: Public works 183,425 = General Fund 100,403 (Garbage department, p16) + Street Fund 83,022
issues.issue: Mixed line: garbage (utilities) 100,403 is larger than streets 83,022. The dominant-category rule would make it utilities, but streets/highways is defensible for a printed 'Public works' line.
The same label in the General Fund detail (detail[31], detail[50]) uses detail_category 'Fuel / Vehicle'. The business-type line is in other, so the two are inconsistent.
The Street, Debt Service and CDA schedules print only a 'Budget (Original)' column, but the variance is headed 'Final Budget'. The original budget is recorded as budget_final.
